summary: Phase 2.2 commercial access enforcement and entitlement ownership code was reviewed without edits from the independent database, architecture, and characterization agents. The entitlement migration verifier checks the exact PostgreSQL pg_get_constraintdef form for the ledger state check, convalidated/deferrability flags, exact primary-key definition, strict rolled_back ledger shape, and transactional ledger CREATE plus COMMENT. The adjacent access-projection rollback validator now validates the complete rolled_back manifest, accepts legitimate non-owned native indexes that survive DOWN, and rejects stale extra rows. Fresh PostgreSQL 17.5 access-projection tests passed, including repeated DOWN and extra-row regressions; the entitlement PostgreSQL suite passed on PostgreSQL 17.5, with the prior PostgreSQL 16 proof retained, and independent database/architecture review passed on PostgreSQL 16 and 17.5. The focused direct API/access matrix command go test -mod=readonly ./middleware ./router ./model -run 'CommercialAccess|PrivateMVP.*Access|PrivateMVPModelList|CommercialPlanEntitlement' -count=1 passed. The affected package suite, go vet, focused MVP race selection, gofmt, and staged/unstaged diff checks passed. The full Phase 2 gate remains pending quota atomicity, Redis concurrency/image limiting, and fail-closed outage recovery; Stripe payment, live providers, production deployment, customer invitations, staging/commit, and launch were not performed.
